The existing test `nesting selector with atrule and comment` (compileStyle.spec.ts:50) already covers the exact issue scenario — it wraps `@media` declarations in `&[data-v-test]` — and it now passes, along with all 413 compiler-sfc tests.

**Fix summary** in `packages/compiler-sfc/src/style/pluginScoped.ts`:
- Added `extractAndWrapNodes()` which pulls declarations and comments out of a rule or at-rule and wraps them in a `& { ... }` host rule.
- In `rewriteSelector`, when a rule has nested rules and isn't `:deep`, it now also applies this wrapping to each at-rule child (e.g. `@media`, `@container`), so scoped declarations inside them get the nesting selector `&[data-v-...]` instead of remaining bare.
